title.zh: 药品（停止对医疗器械适用本法）命令 2010
title.en: Medicines (Cessation of Application of Act to Medical Devices) Order 2010

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Medicines (Cessation of Application of Act to Medical Devices) Order 2010 and shall come into operation on 10th August 2010.
2. In this Order, “medical device” means a medical device referred to in the First Schedule to the Health Products Act (Cap. 122D).
3. The provisions of the Act shall cease to apply to any medical device as from 10th August 2010.
